initial_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production game menu decorative maintenance robot sprite, transparent PNG, landscape 1024x768.
Input image is STYLE REFERENCE only, matching the battered comic CRT/HUD. One small squat wheeled scutter / dustbin utility robot seen from a slightly elevated side three-quarter angle, facing and rolling toward the RIGHT. Short cylindrical trashcan-like metal body, domed hinged lid, one small dark camera lens on an industrial mounting, big rubber drive wheels at its base with visible ivory hub and orange worn wheel guards, a tiny trailing caster, tucked-away little utility grabber. Practical battered shipboard cleaning robot, no human, no specific franchise robot design. Dirty ivory paint, charcoal understructure, restrained burnt orange panels. Heavy confident black brush inks, crosshatching, dry-brush scars and coarse halftone shading, matching the reference. A compact readable silhouette that works at 150 pixels wide.
Composition: entire robot fits inside image with 5 percent transparent margins; wheels contact a common horizontal ground line at about 90 percent canvas height. The robot fills most of the canvas width and height. A faint soft charcoal contact shadow directly beneath the wheels only, otherwise actual transparent background. No floor, no room, no background scene, no scenery. No motion streaks or text. No words, letters, numbers, logo, badge or watermark. The sprite will move horizontally across an existing spaceship floor, and may be mirrored to face left. Keep camera orthographic-like and wheels round, no dramatic perspective or oversized head.
side_profile_revision:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: production transparent game maintenance robot sprite, 4:3 landscape.
Input image 1 is the edit target robot. Input image 2 is the comic style reference. Change the robot's CAMERA to a STRICT 90-DEGREE SIDE ELEVATION, like a side-scrolling platform game sprite, facing directly RIGHT. No three-quarter view, no isometric perspective. The trashcan-like cylindrical body is viewed from its side as a simple upright industrial silhouette. The large near-side drive wheel is a perfect circle seen flat side-on. The far-side drive wheel is fully hidden behind the near-side wheel/body. One little trailing caster is visible behind to the LEFT, and a short tucked utility gripper points to the RIGHT. Its small camera looks toward the right edge, never toward the viewer. Do not show the front face of the robot. There should be no converging perspective in the casing, no visible top surface of the lid (just its side profile). Maintain the robot's battered ivory paint, muted orange panels, charcoal rubber, big brush-ink edges, drybrush scratches and comic crosshatching. Compact squat wheeled trashcan scutter silhouette, clear at 150px wide. Whole robot visible with 5 percent clear margins, wheels on same horizontal baseline, small faint contact shadow beneath wheels. True alpha background. No floor or room, no text, no logo, no motion streaks.
usage: Strict side-on sprite; mirrored at runtime for leftward crossings. Direction and fast/slow duration are chosen independently.
